IS 18815 : 2024 Textiles - Determination of Volatile Organic Compound - Methods of Test - Head-Space and Automatic Liquid Sampler (ALS) Gas Chromatographic Mass Selective Detector Method
ICS 59.080.01
ICS 59.080.01
TXD 05
TXD 05
1 SCOPE
This standard prescribes method for determination of volatile organic compound in textiles and textile products.
NOTE - A number of further derivatives and nonpolar compounds with similar physical properties may also be determined by this method. The applicability of the method should be verified.
